name: Requests Second Factor
description: Some system sends its users to Duo for a second factor through this Duo application — Okta using Duo as an authenticator, a VPN or RADIUS client through the Duo Authentication Proxy, SSH hosts running duo_unix, RDP hosts, a web app using the Web SDK. The source is deliberately open (omitted): the protected system belongs to another plugin (an Okta org, a host, a VPN), and naming those types here would make duo depend on each of them. The source initiates the request; Duo answers it.

mechanism.description: How the system reaches Duo: the Universal Prompt (OIDC redirect), the retired traditional iframe prompt, direct Auth API calls, or the Duo Authentication Proxy as RADIUS or LDAP. `other` for a mechanism not listed.

fail_mode.description: What the client does when Duo is unreachable: `safe` lets the user in without a second factor (fail open), `secure` denies (fail closed). Configured on the client (duo_unix, the Authentication Proxy, Windows Logon), not in Duo — so it is observable only from the protected system's configuration. Absent means not observed.
